description: Complete 16-prompt held-out complement (10 WordPress-suitable + 6 negative controls) from apeatling/wp-agent-benchmark Suite 0.4.0 that were NOT used during development of WPAX skills, registry, or check-fit heuristics. Prompts with eval_subset=true form a 9-prompt stratified subset (1 per kind across all 9 kinds: 6 suitable + 3 controls) for live multi-arm agent experiments.
